```{r}
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
#Sports cars
Dataset <- read_csv("~/Desktop/Data Science Project/Dataset.csv")
Dataset %>% 
  glimpse()
#US sales
Dataset_2 <- read_csv("~/Desktop/Data Science Project/Dataset 2.csv")
Dataset_2 %>% 
  glimpse()
```

Join Datasets
```{r}
Dataset <- Dataset %>% 
  mutate(Model = paste(`Car Make`, `Car Model`, sep = " "))
Dataset <- Dataset %>% 
  distinct(Model, .keep_all = TRUE)
Dataset_2$...14 <- NULL
Dataset_2$...15 <- NULL
merge <- left_join(Dataset_2, Dataset, by = "Model")

Altered_Dataset <- Altered_Dataset %>%
  mutate(Horsepower = gsub("\\+", "", Horsepower))
Altered_Dataset$Horsepower <- as.numeric(Altered_Dataset$Horsepower)
```

1) How many sports cars are sold in the US? Are there American car models not sold yearly?
```{r}
US_specific <- merge %>% 
  filter_all(all_vars(!is.na(.)))
num1 <- Dataset_2 %>% 
  count()
num2 <- US_specific %>% 
count()
(num2/num1)*100
#18 sports cars are sold in US
#Remaining 289 models are not sold
```

2) Do the cars with bigger engines have more horsepower? Does the engine size effect the 0-60 MPH time?
```{r}
Compare1 <- Altered_Dataset %>% 
  select(Model, `Engine Size (L)`, Horsepower, `0-60 MPH Time (seconds)`) 

Engines <- Compare1 %>% 
  arrange(desc(`Engine Size (L)`)) %>% 
  na.omit()
print(Engines)

Horsepower <- Compare1 %>% 
  arrange(desc(Horsepower)) 
print(Horsepower)

Sixty_Seconds <- Compare1 %>% 
  arrange((`0-60 MPH Time (seconds)`)) 
print(Sixty_Seconds)

#There does not seem to be a correlation between cars with big engines and the car's horsepower and a small overlap in cars with bigger engine sizes and the car's acceleration for 0-60 MPH time.
```

3) Are the cars with the largest horsepower more expensive?
```{r}
Compare2 <- Altered_Dataset %>% 
  select(Model, Horsepower, `Price (in USD)`) 

Horsepower <- Compare2 %>% 
  arrange(desc(Horsepower)) 
print(Horsepower)

Price <- Compare2 %>% 
  arrange(desc(`Price (in USD)`)) 
print(Price)

#While there is some overlap, I do not think there is a correlation between cars with the largest horsepower and their price.
```

4) Which car make on average cost the most?
```{r}
Expensive <- Altered_Dataset %>% 
  group_by(`Car Make`) %>% 
  summarize(average_count = mean(`Price (in USD)`, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  rename(cars = 'Car Make')
ggplot(Expensive, aes(x = average_count, y = cars, fill = cars)) +
  geom_col() + 
  labs(
    x = "Average",
    y = "Car Make"
  )
```

5) How many of the cars sold in the US are amongst the cars with the top horsepower? How many are amongst the most expensive?
```{r}
Altered_Dataset$Horsepower <- as.numeric(Altered_Dataset$Horsepower)
#Top Horsepower
ggplot(US_specific, aes(x = Model, y = Horsepower, fill = Model)) +
  geom_col() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Model",
    y = "Horsepower"
  )
US_specific %>% 
  select(Model, Horsepower) %>% 
  arrange(desc(Horsepower))
Altered_Dataset %>% 
  select(Model, Horsepower) %>% 
  arrange(desc(Horsepower))

#Most expensive
ggplot(US_specific, aes(x = Model, y = `Price (in USD)`, fill = Model)) +
  geom_col() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Model",
    y = "Price"
  )
US_specific %>% 
  select(Model, `Price (in USD)`) %>% 
  arrange(desc(`Price (in USD)`))
Altered_Dataset %>% 
  select(Model, `Price (in USD)`) %>% 
  arrange(desc(`Price (in USD)`))
#The cars sold in the US are not amongst the top fastest or most expensive cars in the world
```

6) Which car makes sold the most cars, on average, in a given month?
```{r}
Revised_2 <- Dataset_2 %>%
  mutate(across(-Model, ~as.numeric(gsub(",", "", .))))
Revised_2 <- Revised_2 %>%
  mutate(Sales = rowMeans(across(-Model), na.rm = TRUE))
top_sales <- Revised_2 %>% 
   arrange(desc(Sales))
print(top_sales)
```

Dataset 1 Chart
```{r}
#Top 10 most expensive sports cars
Altered_Dataset1 <- Altered_Dataset %>% 
  arrange(desc(`Price (in USD)`)) 
Top <- head(Altered_Dataset1, n = 10)
ggplot(Top, aes(x = Model, y = `Price (in USD)`, fill = Model)) +
  geom_col()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Model",
    y = "Price"
  )

#Top 10 fastest sports cars
Altered_Dataset <- Altered_Dataset %>%
  mutate(Horsepower = gsub("\\+", "", Horsepower))
Altered_Dataset2 <- Altered_Dataset %>% 
  arrange((Horsepower))
Top <- head(Altered_Dataset2, n = 10)
ggplot(Top, aes(x = Model, y = as.numeric(Horsepower), fill = Model)) +
  geom_col() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Model",
    y = "Horsepower"
  )
```

Dataset 2 Chart
```{r}
Revised_2 <- Dataset_2 %>%
  mutate(across(-Model, ~as.numeric(gsub(",", "", .))))
Revised_2 <- Revised_2 %>%
  mutate(Sales = rowMeans(across(-Model), na.rm = TRUE))
top_sales <- Revised_2 %>% 
  top_n(10, wt = Sales)
ggplot(top_sales, aes(x = Sales, y = Model, fill = Model)) +
  geom_col() +  
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Sales",
    y = "Model"
  )
```
